summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing of ECO.NOVA waste codes replacement - all 431 official Ukrainian waste codes from Національний перелік відходів (Постанова КМУ №1102) are successfully deployed and functioning correctly
passed_tests: GET /api/waste/categories?accepted=true returns 13 categories with total count 431
GET /api/waste/codes?accepted=true&limit=1000 returns 431 codes, all with accepted=true and official=true
GET /api/waste/codes filtered by category (oils) returns correct codes
GET /api/waste/codes/13-02-05 returns full code detail with category, hazardous flag, storage, transport, process info
POST /api/waste/price with code and weight returns price estimate (27 UAH/kg for 100kg = 2700 UAH)
GET /api/waste/admin/stats returns total=431, accepted=431, hazardous=196, official=431, chapters=18, groups=81
Hazardous codes validation: 196 codes ending with * all have hazardous=true, 235 non-hazardous codes correctly have hazardous=false
